findings.allocation: One RUNNING Fargate task consumed one address from a /28 subnet: 11 to 10. DescribeNetworkInterfaces exposed the same primary private IPv4 and MAC as the ECS attachment.
findings.ownership: RequesterManaged=true, Status=in-use, description=ECS attachment ARN, AWS-owned requester/instance owner IDs, no EC2 instance ID, and an Amazon-owned public IPv4 association. Those observed AWS account IDs and public IP are not stable configuration values.
findings.mutation: Description, source/destination checking, security-group change, secondary-address assignment and detach each returned AuthFailure. Delete returned InvalidParameterValue because the ENI was in use. Customer tags succeeded.
findings.dependencies: Live task ENI blocked DeleteSecurityGroup and DeleteSubnet with DependencyViolation. StopTask released the ENI before networking cleanup.
findings.audit: Creation and successful deletion used the AWSServiceRoleForECS assumed-role session ecs-eni-provisioning, invokedBy/sourceIPAddress/userAgent ecs.amazonaws.com. The direct customer deletion denial remained an IAMUser event.
findings.cleanup: Task stopped; cluster INACTIVE with zero running/pending tasks. ENI/gateway/SG/subnet/VPC independently NotFound. Task definition admitted to DELETE_IN_PROGRESS; historical definition is not live infrastructure.
